compute_mae: compute the mean absolute error between prediction and target tensors for a given key
compute_mse: compute the mean squared error between prediction and target tensors for a given key
compute_per_atom_mae: compute the per-atom mean absolute error normalized by the number of atoms in each system
evaluate_energy_forces_within_threshold: evaluate the fraction of systems where energy error is below 0.02 and max force error is below 0.03
lookup_metrics_function: look up and return a metric function by its string name using the get_metrics_fn utility
